text:
sarah_m: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from the autoscale quota spike on 2056-07-15. Saw the recurring pattern: request surges + cold KV cache + scheduler backpressure. Need owners on remediation items and an ETA for each.

mike_g: I can own the autoscale tuning changes. Planning to run a 48h simulator with current traces to pick new thresholds. ETA end of week. :+1:

anya: I'll take runbook updates and the postmortem doc edits (add decision matrix for fallback models + quota escalation path). Goal: docs + checklist by Tue.

leo_ops: I'll drive headroom planning — think we should add a small reserved pool for short spikes (10% of reserved GPUs) and a fast fallback model routing. Need an infra PR to expose reservation knob. ETA next Wed.

olivia_pm: Can we tie the customer-impacting signals to alerts? Last time paging only triggered after sustained latency. We need lead indicators.

mike_g: Agreed. Tests I'm running will include simulated cold-cache spikes. If we shift scale-up threshold from 70% util -> 60% util and reduce cooldown from 5m -> 90s, that should cut tail latency. But cost delta looks like +12% in simulation. Will include cost/perf tradeoff.

sarah_m: Good. Please add numbers to the ticket. Also capture risk: more scale churn may expose scheduling stress.

leo_ops: For scheduler tuning, proposal: prioritize preemption for best-effort jobs, and add a fairness weight to inference pods so they get preference during reclaim. I sketched a kube-scheduler predicate change.

mike_g: Share the simulator command I'm using:
```
# replay traces at 10x to stress autoscaler
./simulator --trace traces/2026-07-15.json --rate-mult 10 --policy current
```

mike_g: I'll attach results in the ticket (latency p99, cost delta, scale events).

anya: On runbook, I'll add new step: if autoscaler issues >3 failures in 1h, trigger immediate fallback to smaller model pool and notify infra. Also adding playbook snippet for reserving headroom using the new knob.

infra-bot: Note: Scheduled infra maintenance next Thursday 03:00-05:00 UTC — may affect the simulation windows.

leo_ops: Good call, I'll avoid that window.

olivia_pm: Can we set a short-term mitigation: soft quota per-tenant to throttle heavy bursty customers at the edge? That could buy headroom while infra changes land.

sarah_m: Yes — assign to product/eng to draft throttling policy. anya, can you coordinate with @olivia_pm for wording and customer messaging?

anya: On it. I'll draft a short policy + email template.

mike_g: Owner summary (to be added to ticket): mike_g -> autoscale thresholds sims (EOW), leo_ops -> scheduler + headroom PR (next Wed), anya -> runbook + customer messaging (Tue), olivia_pm -> escalation/monitoring requirements.

sarah_m: Timeline noted. We'll reconvene Fri standup to review simulation numbers and decide whether to push thresholds to canary. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
